name: docs_fetcher
description: Fetch a documentation webpage and summarize it, extract API documentation specifically, find a specific named section, compare two documentation pages, or extract all code examples from a page.

action.description: summarize: general overview. api_docs: extract endpoints/auth/params. find_section: locate one named section. compare: diff two doc pages. examples: extract code samples.

url.description: Documentation URL. Required for summarize, api_docs, find_section, examples.

summary_length.description: Only used for action='summarize'. Defaults to 'medium'.

section_name.description: Name of the section to find. Required for action='find_section'.

url1.description: First URL to compare. Required for action='compare'.

url2.description: Second URL to compare. Required for action='compare'.
